# Los Angeles Times

> Major U.S. news organization covering Los Angeles, California, national, and global news, culture, sports, business, and opinion.

The Los Angeles Times publishes breaking news, investigations, explainers, reviews, newsletters, podcasts, and service journalism, with dedicated coverage of Southern California alongside national politics, entertainment, food, travel, and sports.

## News
- [California](https://www.latimes.com/california): Statewide news, policy, public safety, housing, environment, and politics coverage from across California.
- [Los Angeles](https://www.latimes.com/california): Reporting focused on Los Angeles communities, local government, transportation, crime, and civic life.
- [Nation](https://www.latimes.com/world-nation): U.S. national news, federal policy, elections, courts, and major domestic developments.
- [World](https://www.latimes.com/world-nation): International reporting, global conflicts, diplomacy, and major world events.
- [Politics](https://www.latimes.com/politics): Coverage of campaigns, government, legislation, elections, and political analysis.
- [Environment](https://www.latimes.com/environment): Climate, wildfires, drought, conservation, energy, and environmental policy reporting.
- [Science & Medicine](https://www.latimes.com/science): Research, public health, medicine, space, and science news coverage.

## Investigations & Projects
- [Investigations](https://www.latimes.com/california/investigations): Accountability reporting, watchdog journalism, public records work, and in-depth investigative projects.
- [Column One](https://www.latimes.com/topic/column-one): Signature longform storytelling featuring deeply reported narratives and distinctive California stories.
- [Essential California](https://www.latimes.com/newsletters/essential-california): Daily newsletter highlighting the most important California and Los Angeles stories.
- [L.A. Times Studios](https://www.latimes.com/studios): Special editorial projects, branded storytelling, and multimedia features.
- [For the Record](https://www.latimes.com/about/for-the-record): Corrections, clarifications, and updates to published Los Angeles Times reporting.

## Arts & Entertainment
- [Entertainment](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts): Film, television, music, celebrity, and entertainment industry news and features.
- [Movies](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/movies): Film news, reviews, awards coverage, interviews, and industry reporting.
- [Television](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/tv): TV news, reviews, streaming coverage, interviews, and awards reporting.
- [Music](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/music): Music news, album coverage, concerts, artists, and industry developments.
- [Arts](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/arts): Visual arts, architecture, theater, dance, and cultural criticism.
- [Image](https://www.latimes.com/image): Style, design, beauty, and visual culture coverage from the Los Angeles Times.
- [The Envelope](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/awards): Awards-season coverage focused on Oscars, Emmys, and entertainment campaigns.

## Food, Travel & Lifestyle
- [Food](https://www.latimes.com/food): Restaurant news, recipes, dining guides, cooking advice, and food culture reporting.
- [Travel](https://www.latimes.com/travel): Destinations, travel tips, California getaways, and trip-planning inspiration.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.latimes.com/lifestyle): Wellness, relationships, home, culture, and everyday life coverage.
- [Boiling Point](https://www.latimes.com/food/newsletter): Food newsletter covering restaurants, recipes, and Southern California dining trends.
- [Plants](https://www.latimes.com/lifestyle/story/2023-04-20/plant-newsletter-sign-up): Newsletter for gardeners and plant enthusiasts with practical growing advice.
- [The Wild](https://www.latimes.com/travel/newsletter): Travel newsletter featuring destination ideas, tips, and California escapes.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.latimes.com/sports): Comprehensive sports coverage, analysis, columns, scores, and breaking news.
- [Dodgers](https://www.latimes.com/sports/dodgers): News, game coverage, analysis, and commentary on the Los Angeles Dodgers.
- [Lakers](https://www.latimes.com/sports/lakers): Reporting, analysis, and commentary on the Los Angeles Lakers.
- [Clippers](https://www.latimes.com/sports/clippers): News and analysis covering the Los Angeles Clippers.
- [USC Sports](https://www.latimes.com/sports/usc): Coverage of USC football, basketball, recruiting, and college athletics.
- [UCLA Sports](https://www.latimes.com/sports/ucla): Coverage of UCLA athletics, including football, basketball, and recruiting.
- [Soccer](https://www.latimes.com/sports/soccer): Coverage of MLS, international soccer, and Southern California clubs.

## Business & Technology
- [Business](https://www.latimes.com/business): Markets, companies, labor, real estate, media, and economic news coverage.
- [Technology](https://www.latimes.com/business/technology): Tech industry reporting, startups, platforms, AI, and digital policy news.
- [Real Estate](https://www.latimes.com/business/real-estate): Housing market news, home prices, development, and property trends.
- [Housing & Homelessness](https://www.latimes.com/homeless-housing): Reporting on housing affordability, homelessness, and public policy responses.
- [Company Town](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/business): Entertainment business reporting on Hollywood, media, and streaming economics.

## Opinion
- [Opinion](https://www.latimes.com/opinion): Editorials, columns, commentary, endorsements, and reader perspectives.
- [Editorials](https://www.latimes.com/opinion/editorials): Institutional editorials from the Los Angeles Times editorial board.
- [Op-Ed](https://www.latimes.com/opinion/op-ed): Guest essays and outside commentary on politics, culture, and public affairs.
- [Letters to the Editor](https://www.latimes.com/opinion/letters-to-the-editor): Reader responses and public feedback on current issues.
- [Columnists](https://www.latimes.com/people): Directory of Los Angeles Times journalists, columnists, and contributors.

## Puzzles, Comics & Games
- [Crossword](https://www.latimes.com/games/daily-crossword): Daily crossword puzzle from the Los Angeles Times games section.
- [Sudoku](https://www.latimes.com/games/sudoku): Daily Sudoku puzzles with multiple difficulty levels.
- [Jumble](https://www.latimes.com/games/jumble): Daily Jumble word puzzle and archived game entries.
- [Comics](https://www.latimes.com/comics): Comic strips and cartoons published by the Los Angeles Times.
- [Games](https://www.latimes.com/games): Hub for puzzles, word games, and interactive brain teasers.

## Audio, Video & Newsletters
- [Podcasts](https://www.latimes.com/podcasts): Los Angeles Times podcasts covering news, culture, sports, and narrative storytelling.
- [Newsletters](https://www.latimes.com/newsletters): Full directory of newsletters across news, food, travel, politics, and culture.
- [Video](https://www.latimes.com/video): Video journalism, interviews, explainers, and documentary-style reporting.
- [The Times Podcast](https://www.latimes.com/podcasts/the-times): Flagship daily news podcast focused on California and major stories.
- [Short Docs](https://www.latimes.com/video/short-docs): Short documentary videos and visual storytelling projects.

## Archives, E-Edition & Obituaries
- [Archives](https://www.latimes.com/archives): Searchable archive of past Los Angeles Times articles and historical coverage.
- [E-Edition](https://www.latimes.com/eedition): Digital replica of the print newspaper edition.
- [Obituaries](https://www.latimes.com/obituaries): Death notices, remembrances, and obituary coverage.
- [From the Archives](https://www.latimes.com/topic/from-the-archives): Historical articles and retrospective archival features.
- [Print Version](https://www.latimes.com/printversion): Access point for print-style reading and newspaper presentation.

- [Subscribe](https://www.latimes.com/subscriptions): Subscription offers and digital or print access options.

- [Help Center](https://www.latimes.com/help): Customer support resources for subscriptions, delivery, and account questions.
- [Contact Us](https://www.latimes.com/about/contact-us): Contact information for newsroom, customer service, and departments.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.latimes.com/about/terms-of-service): Terms governing use of Los Angeles Times digital products and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.latimes.com/about/privacy-policy): Privacy practices, data collection, and user rights information.
